plan.title: Installation Plan
plan.description: This plan was built by the shared dependency-first planner. Blocked and manual items are not executed.
plan.helpTrusted: FreshWin executes only typed arguments resolved from the trusted catalog.
plan.dryPrompt: Press Enter to validate, S to preview saving, E to edit, or 0 to cancel.
plan.executePrompt: Type YES exactly to execute, S to save, E to edit, or 0 to cancel.
plan.reviewOnlyPrompt: Choose S to save, E to edit the selection, or 0 to cancel.
plan.savePrompt: Enter a new absolute .json path for the plan.
plan.savePreview: Dry-run preview: the plan would be saved to {0}; no file was written.

plan.confirmationInvalid: Confirmation was not accepted; review the displayed commands.
plan.resultsDescription: Process completion and independent verification are reported separately.
plan.helpManual: Manual and unknown outcomes still need review.
plan.helpReboot: A reboot-required status is not treated as failure.
plan.rebootDescription: FreshWin stopped before the user-scope phase. Restart Windows, then resume from the protected checkpoint.
plan.rebootNotRegistered: Automatic resume is not registered unless you explicitly choose R.
plan.rebootHelp: FreshWin never restarts Windows automatically. Resume rebuilds the plan from the trusted catalog and current state.

execution.verification: A successful process exit is not reported as installed until post-install detection succeeds.
execution.wait: Execution is in progress. No input is required.
execution.retry: Retry through a newly reviewed plan

execution.failurePrompt: Choose Retry, Details, Log, Skip, or Back.
execution.successPrompt: Press Enter or choose 0 to return.
execution.invalidResultCommand: Choose one of the displayed result actions.

network.title: Network Rescue
network.description: This plan is read-only guidance. It does not download a driver, install an INF, change an adapter, or claim connectivity.
network.helpInf: Local INF matches remain review-only until identity and signature are independently validated.
network.helpOfficial: Acquire missing drivers only from the PC/OEM or adapter manufacturer.
network.helpFolder: F scans a bounded absolute local folder, including a directly attached USB drive; network shares and reparse points are refused.
network.helpRetry: R runs at most three read-only connectivity probes and never changes an adapter.
network.folderRequired: A local driver folder is required.
network.scanComplete: Local folder scan complete; review-only INF matches: {0}.

ddu.title: ADVANCED: DDU Recovery Plan
ddu.description: DDU is an external advanced repair workflow, not a routine update. FreshWin never downloads, stores, or executes a cleanup binary or arguments.
ddu.helpPrepare: Prepare a verified official replacement driver and an external safety checkpoint before manual cleanup.
ddu.helpAcknowledge: Acknowledgement advances only the in-memory plan state; it does not run DDU.
ddu.acknowledge: Acknowledge advanced risk for plan only
ddu.prompt: Type ACKNOWLEDGE exactly to advance the plan, or 0.
ddu.acknowledgedDescription: The guarded recovery state machine is ready for replacement-driver preparation. Cleanup remains completely manual and outside FreshWin.
ddu.automatic: Automatic cleanup: {0} | automatic download: {1} | automatic execution: {2}
ddu.helpApi: Use the exported operation API only to record explicit manual evidence and validated state transitions.
ddu.helpCheckpoint: The ddu-plan CLI --output option stores only a validated non-executing plan checkpoint; it never registers startup execution or reboots Windows.

drivers.description: Device health is query-only. GPU recommendations point only to official OEM or GPU-vendor workflows; FreshWin does not silently replace drivers.
drivers.helpNetwork: N opens the non-executing network rescue plan.
drivers.helpDdu: D opens an explicit ADVANCED DDU plan-only workflow.
drivers.helpRefresh: R repeats read-only hardware, driver, and network observations.
drivers.helpManual: Driver replacement remains manual unless a trusted catalog package can be independently detected and verified.
drivers.refreshed: Hardware, drivers, GPU guidance, and network rescue state refreshed.

diagnostics.readOnly: All diagnostics on this page are read-only. Unknown is not converted to pass or failure.
diagnostics.noConclusion: No health conclusion was inferred from the failure.
diagnostics.description: Review the composed system, hardware, network, security, driver, update, activation, and readiness observations.
diagnostics.helpExport: E creates a new privacy-redacted diagnostics bundle after confirmation.
diagnostics.helpRepair: Use package centers to plan repairs for catalog packages reported as broken.
diagnostics.safetyHelp: FreshWin never bypasses activation, Secure Boot, TPM, Windows eligibility, or security controls.
diagnostics.noReport: No diagnostic report is available to export.
diagnostics.absoluteRequired: The diagnostics output directory must be an absolute path.
diagnostics.confirmPrompt: Create a new redacted diagnostics bundle? Type YES
diagnostics.preview: Diagnostics export preview completed; no files were written.
